text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I went to the park to take a breather—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*~.
It's so relaxing and soothing~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, honestly, Sei-chan looks like
she's about to fall asleep holding her rice bowl.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. This is called a "nodate."
It's an outdoor tea ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you care to join me?
You don't need to mind proper etiquette,
so please make yourself comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, look, I even prepared extra
tea snacks~ Ufufu♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You can totally chill out and relax outdoors,
so open-air tea ceremonies are the best, aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My♪
In that case, would you like to take up tea ceremony formally?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, sitting still in seiza for so long is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Sei-chan just wants to bask in the warm sunshine like this."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but getting to eat Japanese sweets is great.
They're so gently sweet, I could eat them forever♪
choice_data_list: You just can't stop once you start, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, I know.
Besides, as long as I burn off what I eat, it's fine, right?"
choice_data_list: In that case, you better hold back on slacking off.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly.
We have to burn off everything we just ate."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's do our tandem run together after this, Sei-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Is this why you invited
Trainer along?!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu...
Now, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Grass Wonder's clever attentiveness,
Seiun Sky ran enough to burn off everything she ate.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Right? Totally!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The sweetness of wagashi and the astringency of green tea
go together so amazingly well!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We still have plenty prepared,
so please, help yourselves without holding back~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~, bliss-ful-ness~~.
Since I'm here, I might as well try every single flavor♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Seiun Sky and I ended up eating far too many Japanese sweets together.
